mechanism: Memory pool of generation guides from previously solved tasks, retrieved by hybrid SBERT/BM25 similarity
evidence_scope: When a task is completed successfully (it passes both visible and hidden test cases), we call the GPT-4o-mini API to generate the set of keywords Ki based on the task description Q and the generated code C.
evidence_role: we introduce a novel architecture of LLM-based agents for code generation and automatic debugging: Refinement and Guidance Debugging (RGD).
